The '''Zapertine Cup''' was a [[Podracing/Legends|Podrace]] held on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korrilan IV/Legends|Korrilan IV]]. The series of races were only eligible to [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|racers]] piloting [[CR-17 Incendia/Legends|CR-17 Incendia]] Podracers.<ref name="EV" />
